Implemented docs/design/frontend-auth.md §5.2 rank 4 and §6.6. New crates/mimid-agent/src/local_ca.rs: the CA and its leaf in the state directory (keys 0600, certificates 0644), name-constrained (RFC 5280 §4.2.1.10) to exactly the [tls] names as DNS-name and IP-address permitted subtrees with pathLenConstraint 0, a 90-day leaf remade past 60 days, a local-ca.names sidecar so changing the names remakes both, the SHA-256 fingerprint, the Apple .mobileconfig and the install page. tls.rs gains TlsSource::LocalCa and [tls.local-ca], renewing through the existing reload loop. http.rs serves /mimid/ca and its two downloads with no credential (decision mimid-1wgh.127), as a guard exception so the Host check still applies. daemon.rs adds the plain-HTTP bootstrap listener, which answers those three paths and 404s everything else. cli.rs adds , printing the fingerprint the user compares with the page.

THE SECURITY PROPERTY IS TESTED PROPERLY: local_ca.rs's unit test signs a leaf for bank.example WITH THE CA'S OWN KEY and a real path verifier (rustls-webpki, a new dev-dependency) refuses it. A first attempt only showed a wrong-issuer failure, which proves nothing about the constraint; that test was replaced.

New dependencies: rcgen 0.14.5 (aws_lc_rs and pem, no ring, per decision mimid-1wgh.26) and time 0.3.55 for rcgen's validity dates, both pinned; rustls-webpki as a dev-dependency.

Tests: tests/local_ca.rs (4) and 4 unit tests in the module. All gates green, full suite with no failures.

FOUND ALONG THE WAY: bead mimid-036n, a teardown race in which Daemon::serve can return while an axum per-connection task still holds the store, so reopening the state directory fails. It is not fixed; bead mimid-e13m.6's ConnectInfo was scoped to the TLS listener to keep the window as narrow as it was before.
